title: A polynomial moment approach to a rank condition for continuous-stage Runge--Kutta methods
summary: In the study of energy-preserving methods for Hamiltonian systems, polynomial continuous-stage Runge--Kutta methods play an important role. Necessary and sufficient conditions for such methods to be energy-preserving have already been established. They are energy-preserving if the matrix $M\in \mathbb{R}^{s\times s}$ defining the method is symmetric, and the converse holds under the assumption that a certain $s\times \infty$ matrix $Φ^\mathrm{CSRK}$ has full row rank.
